input: Compile a contact list for freelance client outreach

gold.taskTitle: Compile a Freelance Client Outreach Contact List
gold.taskDescription: Build a targeted contact list of potential clients to reach out to for freelance work opportunities.

questions.title: What type of freelance work are you offering?
questions.description: Identify the specific freelance service or skill set (e.g., graphic design, copywriting, web development) to ensure the contact list targets the right audience.

questions.title: What industries or niches are you targeting?
questions.description: Narrow down the specific industries, sectors, or niches the user wants to focus on for outreach.

questions.title: How many contacts do you want to collect?
questions.description: Define a target number or range of contacts to be included in the final list.

questions.title: What sources will you use to find contacts?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user plans to use LinkedIn, company websites, freelance platforms, referrals, or other specific sources.

questions.title: What contact details do you need for each entry?
questions.description: Determine the specific data fields required per contact, such as name, email, job title, company, or phone number.

questions.title: What tool will you store the list in?
questions.description: Identify the format or platform the user wants to use to organize and store the list, such as a spreadsheet, CRM, or Notion database.

questions.title: What is your deadline for completing this list?
questions.description: Establish a target date or timeframe by which the contact list needs to be ready for outreach to begin.
